lines.speaker: Ham
lines.text: Don't let the spears fool you. Half of them had never held anything sharper than a harvest sickle when they got here.

lines.speaker: Ham
lines.text: They look like soldiers from far away. Up close they still flinch when someone shouts. Discipline takes years. We've had months.

lines.speaker: Ham
lines.text: Give me one more season of drills and they'll hold a line. Give me a week and they'll hold it until the first charge.
